changes.evidence: Rogue's Brotherhood membership under Mystique ended before the series: she 'left the Brotherhood' and joined Xavier's X-Men before TAS episode 1 (her past is only shown in flashback in S2 ep 9 / episode 22). In S1 ep 12 she fights 'her former teammates in the Brotherhood'.

Gambit 'left her and the guild' before joining the X-Men, all before the series. In TAS S2 ep 6 (episode 19) he goes back to New Orleans to save his brother but tells Bella Donna he is 'neither a thief nor an assassin, but an X-Man' and leaves. He is never a Thieves Guild member during an on-file title.

At the end of TAS (S5 finale), Xavier leaves the X-Men, willing his team and leadership to Magneto, and goes with Lilandra to the Shi'ar. In X-Men '97 S1 ep 6 he is presented to the Shi'ar court as Lilandra's consort. In ep 8 he 'left the Shi'ar behind' and returns to his X-Men.

Thought killed in TAS S1 ep 1, Morph is taken and brainwashed by Mister Sinister and fights the X-Men in S2 eps 1-2 and 12-13 (wiki: 'Formerly: Nasty Boys'). Freed, Morph flees, then rejoins the X-Men in S4 ep 3 (episode 51) and leaves again in the same episode. After Xavier leaves, Morph 'rejoined the team on a permanent basis' and is an X-Man throughout X-Men '97. The record also needs 'X-Men: The Animated Series' in left.

In TAS Bishop is a time traveler from the 2055 mutant resistance (with Forge and Wolverine) who teams up with the X-Men but is not one of them. He keeps going back to his own time. Only at the start of X-Men '97 S1 ep 1, stuck in the 1990s, does he become 'a full-fledged member of the X-Men'.

In X-Men '97 S1 eps 7-9 the grown Cable fights with the X-Men. In ep 9 he is put on the Gold Team against Bastion, and in ep 10 he is listed as AWOL on Forge's X-Men roster (wiki: 'Formerly: X-Men'). He then forms X-Force in S2.

TAS S5 ep 2: after losing Asteroid M he 'retired to the Arctic Circle' and refuses to help until Quicksilver is taken. Later in S5 he leads Genosha. X-Men '97 S1 eps 7-8: having survived Genosha, he is 'kidnapped and imprisoned by Bastion' (OZT) until Val Cooper frees him. In ep 9 he turns against the X-Men and rebuilds Asteroid M on his own, joined only by Rogue and Sunspot. Whether he is back with the X-Men in S2 Egypt is an owner call.

X-Men '97 S1 ep 5: 'Kurt eventually joined Genosha's council as outreach for any communities of faith' and survives the Sentinel attack. 'Following the attack, Kurt joined the X-Men as an official team member' (S1 ep 7). The wiki lists 'Formerly: Interim Council'.

Under 'Joining the X-Men' (X-Men '97 S1 ep 9), Forge and Storm 'went off to rejoin the X-Men after Xavier's call to action'. He is on Gold Team against Bastion, and in ep 10 he is running the X-Men roster. He joins in S1, not S2.
X-Men '97 S1 ep 5: 'Archangel later moved to Genosha and was present at the Gala when a Tri-Sentinel Master Mold attacked'. Cable then recruits him into X-Force in S2.

owner_calls.question: Should Rogue get stages for joining Genosha's council (S1 ep 5) and for defecting to Magneto on Asteroid M (S1 ep 9), and if so under which group names?
options: Keep [X-Men TAS, X-Corp S2] (after the Brotherhood fix)
Add ['Genosha', "X-Men '97 S1"] then ['The X-Men', "X-Men '97 S1"] before X-Corp
Also add a Magneto/Asteroid M stage (e.g. 'Independent' or a named group) in S1 before returning to the X-Men
owner_calls.evidence: S1 ep 5: Magneto takes the Genosha chancellorship on condition Rogue gets a council seat, and 'Rogue decided to accept'. S1 ep 9: 'Unwilling to watch anymore mutants die, she took him up on his offer, joined only by Sunspot', betraying the X-Men. By ep 10 she is fighting Bastion with them again.

owner_calls.question: Sunspot defects to Magneto on Asteroid M in X-Men '97 S1 ep 9 and is back with the X-Men in ep 10. Should that get a stage?
options: Insert ['Independent', "X-Men '97 S1"] then ['The X-Men', "X-Men '97 S1"] after the first X-Men stage
owner_calls.evidence: 'Roberto, now donning an X-Uniform joined Magneto and Rogue after his mom shut him out' (S1 ep 9). In ep 10 he fights Bastion with the X-Men and saves Jubilee.

owner_calls.question: In X-Men '97 S2 (ancient Egypt, eps 13-14), is Magneto back with the X-Men before Apocalypse kills him?
owner_calls.evidence: In S1 ep 10 Xavier heals Magneto's mind and Magneto saves Earth from Asteroid M. In Egypt 'Magneto convinced the other X-Men to ally with' En Sabah Nur, and the wiki lists his current affiliation as X-Men.

owner_calls.question: Iceman's X-Men stage covers membership that ended before the present-day story. He is seen as an X-Man only in a flashback episode (56), and in his present-day appearance (episode 37) he has long since left. Remove it?
options: Keep [X-Men TAS, Independent TAS] because the flashback is on screen in the title
Remove the X-Men stage (B), leaving him with no group stages
owner_calls.evidence: 'When his girlfriend and fellow X-Man Lorna Dane nearly died during a mission, Bobby angrily left the X-Men' before the S3 ep 15 story, in which he refuses to rejoin.
